visual_review: Reads as a ninja at 48 in both themes: hood dome, headband knotted at the side with two tails, eye band with two eye dashes.
omissions: The eye opening is the full-width band between headband and mask edge (an inset rounded slot with eyes inside cannot keep 8 from the chin); eyes are level dashes, not slanted brows.
